name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a creature of evil alignment

powers.name: Fissure of Darkness
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a good creature within 120 ft standing on the ground makes a DC 20 Dex save or falls into a fissure of darkness and is destroyed.

summary: An unholy symbol (+2 spell attacks) with 6 charges that open fissures to swallow good creatures.
text: This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 Necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. A good creature takes 8d6 Necrotic damage upon touching the talisman. If you are an evil Cleric or Paladin, you can use the talisman as a holy symbol, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. The talisman has 6 charges. If you are wearing or holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and choose one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of you. If the target is of good alignment, a fissure opens under it; the target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the fissure and be destroyed, leaving no remains. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed. (The game doesn't track alignment: Celestials count as good.)
